title: Install Git & Configure Your Identity
description: Install Git on your machine and set it up with your name and email. Then verify everything is working.
steps: Download and install Git from https://git-scm.com/downloads
Open your terminal (Command Prompt, Git Bash, or macOS Terminal)
Run: git --version  — confirm you see a version number like 'git version 2.x.x'
Run: git config --list  — verify your name and email appear in the output
expected_output: Terminal shows your git version, and git config --list shows your user.name and user.email correctly set.
tips: Use the same email address you will use on GitHub — this links commits to your GitHub account
On Windows, use Git Bash (installed with Git for Windows) for the best experience
If you already have Git installed, skip to step 3 and check your version
